summary:
KnowYou 1.2.5 improves My Wiki reliability and release polish.

What is new:
- My Wiki Update is more reliable: the bundled runner now keeps app/runner JSON messages separate from diagnostic logs, avoiding rare stuck updates.
- Chinese and other multibyte LLM responses are decoded safely when streamed through the runner bridge.
- My Wiki detail pages handle long titles and related chips more cleanly.
- The bundled MyWiki runner remains inside KnowYou, so users do not need npm.

Release details:
- Version: 1.2.5
- Build: 368
- Released: 2026-06-10
